name: PitchBook
description: Finance and Fintech: private and public capital markets data platform (companies, investors, deals, funds) with a contract-gated Direct Data REST API.
access_notes: The PitchBook API belongs to the Direct Data product and 'requires a standalone contract agreement' separate from a platform subscription. There is no self-serve signup or developer portal; prospects contact the Direct Data team, and existing clients request access via Plugins & Apps in the platform. PitchBook then provisions 'an API key or authentication token'.
mcp_notes: PitchBook operates an official Premium MCP server at premium.mcp.pitchbook.com/mcp (OAuth login; ~11 read tools for companies, deals, funds, investors); an MCP gateway page is live on the official mcp-proxy-external.pitchbook.com domain. No Composio toolkit found (docs.composio.dev/toolkits/pitchbook.md returns 404).
uncertainty_notes: Full API reference (endpoint list, exact auth header, rate limits) is not publicly accessible; it sits behind client authentication, so breadth is estimated from official marketing/help pages (company, fund, deal entities; read-only data retrieval). Third-party sources describe 'Authorization: PB-Token {API_KEY}' but this is not confirmed on an official page. No webhook documentation found publicly. MCP endpoint is on the official pitchbook.com domain but the setup pages I could read are aggregators.

evidence.note: Official help: RESTful API at api.pitchbook.com; 'a separate offering... that requires a standalone contract agreement'; access established 'through an API key or authentication token' via the Direct Data team.
Direct Data API is 'a RESTful JSON' interface for on-demand access to company, fund, and deal entities.
Live 'PitchBook MCP Gateway Production Environment' page on the official pitchbook.com domain with OAuth (Okta) login.
Aggregator listing of the official PitchBook Premium MCP server at premium.mcp.pitchbook.com/mcp with 11 read tools (search, profiles, deals, funds, investors); author: PitchBook.
